_about: Folder names under which student drives keep a course, when the name differs from the synced syllabus name. `drive_sources.py index` maps a file to a course when one of its path parts equals (after normalising quotes and a code in parentheses) the course's synced name or an alias here. Add an alias only after checking that the folder is this course and not a lab, a different-year course, or an elective with a similar name. Curated 2026-11-14 from the folder lists of the TAU and Bar-Ilan drives.
